problemStatement: The eight-crop supervised models can fit training folds but fail held-out-content transfer. The next test should replace from-scratch acoustic note detection with a frozen pretrained AMT front end before spending more optimizer budget.
hypothesis: A frozen pretrained polyphonic note-transcription model can recover pitch/onset events from the same direct-input guitar audio substantially better and more consistently across P1/P2 than the tiny from-scratch event models, making modular note-detection -> string/fret assignment a viable path.

selectedFrontEnd.name: Spotify Basic Pitch
reason: instrument-agnostic and documented as working best on one instrument at a time
provides note and onset outputs directly
cheap zero-optimizer feasibility test separates acoustic note detection from guitar fingering assignment
selectedFrontEnd.versionRule: Pin an exact released package/model version and model hash before any real-media execution; do not use a moving main-branch model.

researchBasis.work: SynthTab: Leveraging Synthesized Data for Guitar Tablature Transcription
researchBasis.finding: Large synthesized pretraining was proposed specifically to mitigate overfitting and improve cross-dataset guitar-tab transcription.

researchBasis.work: TART: A Modular Tool for Technique-Aware Audio-to-Tablature Guitar Transcription
researchBasis.finding: Recent modular guitar-tab work separates audio-to-MIDI from later string/fret assignment and technique modeling.
Lightweight pretrained polyphonic audio-to-MIDI model with explicit note/onset outputs and fixed default decoding parameters.

Recent work emphasizes playability-aware string/fret modeling after acoustic evidence; this supports separating pitch evidence from fingering constraints rather than forcing one tiny per-frame classifier to learn both.

stageA.name: frozen_note_front_end_zero_optimizer_gate
stageA.dataScope: same exact 4 P1 + 4 homologous P2 direct-input captures already used in the combined diagnostic; P3 excluded
stageA.cropRule: Use the same frozen 200-frame crop time bounds for scoring. Front-end inference may require model-native padding/context, but only reference/predicted events intersecting the frozen scoring interval count.

targetTransformation.standardTuningMidiOpenStrings: derive from existing string-order contract and freeze explicitly in implementation
targetTransformation.collapseRule: Convert each scorable source string/fret event to MIDI pitch. Simultaneous duplicate same-pitch events are retained in a separate ambiguity accounting field and are not silently double-counted by a monophonic-per-pitch scorer.
targetTransformation.noStringFretCredit: Stage A gives no credit for string/fret identity.

primary: pitch+onset event precision/recall/F1 at frozen 50 ms onset tolerance
pitch+onset+offset event F1 with frozen offset tolerance
per-content pair macro F1 across P1/P2
secondary: raw prediction count vs reference count
P1 vs P2 absolute F1 gap

criteria: each content pair macro pitch+onset F1 >= 0.50
zero optimizer steps and zero threshold search
all eight frozen capture/crop/source identities verified and unresolved selected labels = 0
advancementCriteria.interpretation: Passing establishes only that pretrained note evidence is promising enough to justify designing a separate string/fret assignment stage. It does not establish tablature accuracy.

failureBranches.frontEndFails: Stop Basic Pitch as the selected front end. Do not tune thresholds on these eight examples. Next offline review should compare one alternative frozen/pretrained front end or synthetic-pretraining strategy.
failureBranches.frontEndPasses: Do not immediately train end-to-end. Design Stage B: a small string/fret assignment layer conditioned on frozen note/pitch evidence plus guitar constraints, with content-grouped validation.
failureBranches.identityOrScoringFails: Stop without scientific interpretation and fix only the offline adapter/scorer.

explicitNonGoals: no string/fret model in Stage A
whyThisIsMateriallyDifferent: It imports broad pretrained acoustic knowledge and decomposes pitch/onset detection from string/fret assignment instead of asking a tiny model to learn acoustic representation, onset detection, state classification, and fingering from eight 200-frame crops.
